records.subject: Traditional inhibitors urotropine, benzotriazole and thiocarbamide
records.quote: The effect of traditional inhibitors of acid corrosion (urotropine, benzotriazole, and thiocarbamide) on the corrosion-electrochemical behavior of an iron plate with a tangential thermal gradient in a sulfate-containing acid solution is examined.
context_quotes: The inhibitors are shown to significantly weaken the thermogalvanic (TG) corrosion intensity, reducing the TG currents and total weight tosses of iron in the thermoelectric zone by factors of 1.3 to 2.0 and 1.1 to 1.4 times, respectively.
